Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly compared the release dates. It identified the dates as November 26, 1965 (Dis-Moi Qui Tuer) and September 15, 2010 (Under The Hawthorn Tree). When comparing these dates chronologically, 1965 is earlier than 2010. However, the Planner concluded that "Under the Hawthorn Tree came out earlier" based on a flawed logic of comparing only the month and day (September 15 vs November 26) while ignoring the year difference. This led to the factually incorrect answer that the 2010 film was released before the 1965 film.
